expected: Measured peak RAM/VRAM/disk, startup and failures; conservative reproducible fit.
limitations: Fit relies on a page file: the engine commits about twice its resident memory; the tested host has 47 GiB RAM and a 31 GB page file.
Stock Strata attributes every unexpected engine exit to RAM in its log message; the observed exits were not memory-related.
observed: Engine lifetime peaks after the whole qualification and evaluation: working set 30.53 GB, private commit 63.35 GB; GPU memory 30,820-30,836 MiB of 32,607 in every sampled gate run; system RAM available while serving never below 9.0 GB (sampled every 2 s); commit headroom 8.3 GB (G10). Integration root 74.2 GB including 4.7 GB of qualification/evaluation workspaces (install alone 69.5 GB). Start to verified readiness 14.4-15.9 s. Across 8 server logs and 629 completed requests: no watchdog stop, no OOM or CUDA error, no traceback; every engine death was induced (G15) or the G14 stale-cancel defect.
